conclusion: The bounded decoded-instruction query found no direct READ operand at city offsets +0x14, +0x18, +0x1C, or +0x20 in 272 function-owned instructions. A reproduced exact-base scan found 31 city-table materializers; a follow-up over the first eight unique functions after excluding the previously followed 0x82CEDF90 path found no such direct reads across 664 instructions. These are bounded direct-operand negatives, not a program-wide reader census. Indexed, computed, stack-reloaded, other-materializer, functionless, and out-of-range readers remain unresolved; the era-indexed words' downstream role and effect are unknown.
